case.title: 'upstream' contains 'stream' mid-word, which must not count as a river keyword

submissions.open_text: The tap attendant opens late and closes early.
submissions.voice_transcript: Our house is upstream from the market, we use the communal tap.

submissions.open_text: Prices rose sharply during the dry season.

case.why: Keywords match only at the start of a word. In 'upstream', 'stream' starts at the third letter, so it is not a match. No other word begins a keyword ('Our house' is not 'our own tap'; 'from' alone is not 'buy from'). The first real match is 'communal tap' (public_tap), which equals the form, so the check stays silent. A plain substring search would find 'stream' first, classify the source as river, and fire wrongly.
